Name: JP's Farms - Bigger Desert Farm
Author: juanpa98ar
Description:
[font=Georgia][size=6][center][b][i][color=#00ff00][u]Bigger Desert Farm[/u][/color][/i][/b][/center][/size]

[color=#00ffff][size=5][b][i]All I see is sand, lots and lots of sand, it's hot, very, very hot, my feet hurt from walking so much... I turned around and I was only a few feet away from the entrance of the house.[/i][/b][/size][/color]


[list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]This farm can be a challenge even for the most experienced farmers, it is summer all the time so you will only have very limited crops, it is very unlikely to rain so you can't depend on that, the sprinklers don't work in the sand and most of all the farm is huge!!!!![/size][/font]
[/list][size=4]
[/size][list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]If you want to enjoy the farm and not have so many difficult problems to solve, you can also configure the farm![/size][/font]
[/list][size=4]
[/size][list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]You can add warps to the farm to move faster, enable the use of sprinklers, allow the growing of all plants at any time of the year and more.[/size][/font]
[/list][size=4]
[/size][list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]You will start the game with 10 Pepper seeds, it will not be difficult to advance this way.[/size][/font]
[/list]
[color=#ff0000][size=5][i]I don't think I'm forgetting anything, that would be all. I hope you enjoy the mod.[/i][/size][/color]
